body: Blue Owl Capital Inc. OWL is readying the sale of $513M of commercial mortgage-backed securities to finance the acquisition of a Northern Virginia data center that's leased to Amazon.com, according to a media report on Thursday.The financing, to be led by Citigroup C, consists of three tranches — including two public offerings and one private placement, Bloomberg News reported, citing people with knowledge of the matter.Some $375M of bonds, with an average life of about five years, are expected to be rated AAA by Fitch Ratings and Kroll Bond Rating Agency, the report said. The initial price being discussed is ~1.95 percentage points over the benchmark.The second portion, amounting to ~$112M, also with an average life of about five years, is expected to be rated AA by Kroll; initial price talk is ~2.6 pp over the benchmark, the people told Bloomberg.The remaining $26M tranche, with an expected rating of AA- by Kroll, is being placed privately, they said.The CMBS is backed by the mortgage on the 54-megawatt Project Crossing III data center, the people told Bloomberg. Amazon's AMZN lease started in March and lasts through 2041, with two five-year renewal options. The company isn't involved in the financing, the report said.Blue Owl Capital Inc.
